integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the defining functional equation, positive Lagrange coefficients, claimed zero atom, normalization statement, mean condition, simulation parameters, and simulation normalization instruction. The foundational Consul-Shenton abstract was inspected at its two-function Lagrange formula. The proof is algebraic and PGF-based; numerical coefficient sums are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects the stated probability normalization and zero mass but does not reassess all fitted regression coefficients or goodness-of-fit comparisons.
The simulation section's numerical normalization may generate a law different from the written analytic PMF; the exact implementation is not reconstructed here.
For the supercritical regime, only the necessary extinction conditioning is identified; inference for the conditioned law is not developed.
title: The RPSL zero mass contradicts its Lagrange equation
